meta.title: Bulk neon sign quotes for businesses and events | Lit Neon
meta.description: Three signs or three hundred: one designer, one proof per design, staged delivery across mainland GB. Request a bulk quote for branches, venues, events, staff gifts and shop windows. Reply within 12 hours.
meta.ogTitle: Bulk and trade neon signs | Lit Neon
meta.ogDescription: One designer, one proof per design, staged delivery. Request a bulk quote and hear back within 12 hours.

h1: Signs for every branch, table and window
lede: Tell us how many and what for. One designer looks after the whole order, sends a proof for every design and replies within 12 hours.
chips: Staged delivery if you need it
heroCaption: Rendered preview: the sign is drawn at true size on the scene

form.lede: Two minutes. Everything except the count and your details is optional.
form.countHelp: From 3 to 200. More than that? Say so in the notes.
form.countMore: More than 200? Tell us in the notes and we’ll plan it with you.
form.countErr: How many signs? Anything from 3 to 200
form.countMin: Bulk quotes start at 3 signs. For one or two, design it yourself or upload your logo.
form.designsNote: We draw a proof for each design, and you approve each one.
form.outdoorNote: Outdoor signs are sealed for the weather and quoted separately. We include them in the same quote.
form.needByNote: Standard is 7–10 working days after you approve the drawings. Tight date? We’ll tell you straight away what’s possible.
form.needByTight: That’s sooner than our standard time. Send it anyway: the designer replies with what’s possible, honestly.
form.budget: Rough budget for the whole order
form.budgetHelp: It helps us suggest sizes and finishes. It never changes the price of a sign.
form.filesLabel: Drop up to 5 files here, or choose them
form.filesHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF · up to 20 MB each
form.filesAria: Add logos or artwork: choose files or drag them here
form.filesType: We can’t read that file. PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF please
form.filesSize: {name} is over 20 MB. Try a smaller export or a PDF
form.filesMax: That’s the five-file limit. Send more with a link in the notes, or we’ll ask for them
form.rights: I have the right to use this artwork
form.name: Your name
form.notesPlaceholder: Wording for each sign, locations, delivery addresses, how it should be split…
form.consent: Also send me the occasional note from the workshop (optional, unsubscribe any time).
form.replyNote: We email your quote to the address above, and use your details for this quote only
form.reassure: Free, no obligation. A designer replies within 12 hours.
